item.title: Family income rose and poverty fell in 2025, but safety net cuts could reverse gains
item.description: A Census Bureau report shows average family income increased in 2025 from the previous year, while the official poverty rate declined.

item.title: Republican Rep. Massie moves to impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth over Iran war
item.description: Kentucky Republican Thomas Massie introduced articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Tuesday over the war in Iran.

item.title: Judge Blocks Plan to Restore Trump's Name at Kennedy Center
item.description: A judge ruled the arts center's board cannot restore Trump's name to the building, stating such a change requires Congressional approval.

item.title: Prosecutors Will Not Seek Death Penalty for Nick Reiner
item.description: Los Angeles County District Attorney Nathan Hochman said his office consulted Reiner's siblings and considered their wishes in the decision.
